title: Tracecat 1.3.0
body_markdown:
## Breaking changes


- fix(api)!: Scope user email search to the caller's organization ([#3862](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3862) )
- fix(rbac+agents)!: Drop agent scopes from the org member floor ([#3826](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3826) )
- feat(skills)!: Redo ai.skill actions to match the MCP server ([#3886](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3886) )


## Security


- security(deps): Patch Next.js image RCE, DOMPurify, OTel, virtualenv ([#3965](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3965) )
- security(mcp): Revoke MCP access when any granted org removes a user ([#3962](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3962) )
- security(api): Add AES-256-GCM option for database encryption ([#3983](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3983) )


## Deprecations


- deprecation(skills): Legacy ai.skill actions in favour of MCP actions ([#3899](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3899) )


## Case management


- feat(cases+ui): Review workflow runs for a case task ([#3843](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3843) )
- fix(cases): Keep select field options and defaults on edit ([#3856](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3856) )
- perf(cases): Load case search results more efficiently ([#3801](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3801) )
- feat(cases+mcp): Add sub-case MCP tools and docs ([#3872](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3872) )
- feat(cases): Select payload fields in case list and search ([#3867](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3867) )
- fix(cases): Sort assignees and tags across all matching cases ([#3802](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3802) )
- feat(cases): Combine conditions in case search ([#3804](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3804) )
- feat(cases): Search cases by words, phrases, and misspellings ([#3808](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3808) )
- docs(cases): Document task workflow runs and refresh screenshots ([#3882](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3882) )
- feat(cases): Add grouped filters and payload equality search ([#3883](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3883) )
- fix(cases): Ignore punctuation-only words in case search ([#3951](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3951) )
- fix(cases): Keep search focused while results load ([#3978](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3978) )
- fix(cases): Show a neutral empty state when case search times out ([#3980](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3980) )
- perf(cases): Speed up case text search with stored search vectors ([#3998](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3998) )
- perf(cases): Match case search typos through stored word lists ([#4004](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4004) )
- fix(infra+cases): Support IBM Cloud's ibm_extension schema ([#4014](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/4014) )


## Tables


- fix(tables): Bump updated_at on row upserts and updates ([#3889](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3889) )


## Agents


- fix(agents): Restore preset builder tabs and playground version picker ([#3854](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3854) )
- fix(agents): Run chat sessions up to the agent timeout ceiling ([#3874](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3874) )
- perf(agents+ui): Stop chat freezing on large streamed tool inputs ([#3887](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3887) )
- fix(agents): Run agent tool calls at highest priority ([#3876](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3876) )
- feat(agents): Refresh agent chat ui and approvals ([#3884](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3884) )
- fix(agents): Drop SDK-unsupported content blocks from chat history ([#3896](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3896) )
- fix(agents): Classify interrupted LLM streams, correlate gateway logs ([#3914](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3914) )
- feat(agents): Raise agent timeout default to 2h and ceiling to 3h ([#3915](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3915) )

- feat(ui+agents): Improve form config editor and chat forms support ([#3927](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3927) )

- docs(agents): Add Timeouts page under Building agents ([#3947](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3947) )
- feat(agents): Steer a running turn from chat ([#3944](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3944) )
- feat(agents): Add session command table and store ([#3961](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3961) )
- feat(agents): List pending messages and expose withdraw to UI extensions ([#3970](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3970) )
- fix(agents): Show missing provider credentials as a chat error ([#3975](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3975) )
- fix(agents): Route managed OpenRouter, Ollama, vLLM, LiteLLM models ([#3981](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3981) )
- feat(agents): Run stdio MCP servers through a pluggable runner ([#3986](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3986) )
- feat(agents): Share the session sink and add caller-owned turn results ([#3992](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3992) )
- feat(agents): Gate non-default agent backends by entitlement ([#3991](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3991) )
- fix(agents): Enforce the shared MCP tool discovery timeout ([#3744](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3744) )
- refactor(agents): Drop the agent-runtime feature flag ([#3993](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3993) )
- feat(agents): Run Slack, comment and MCP agents on the selected backend ([#3990](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3990) )
- feat(agents+ui): Restore builder chat tab on agent presets ([#3963](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3963) )


## Tracecat MCP


- fix(ui+mcp): Leave room below the trigger node in auto layout ([#3863](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3863) )
- feat(mcp): Add tool to configure workspace attachment file types ([#3811](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3811) )
- fix(mcp): Connect multi-org users to their active organization ([#3935](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3935) )
- feat(mcp): Let one OAuth connection cover multiple organizations ([#3957](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3957) )


## Core actions


- fix(actions): Explain DuckDB out-of-memory errors instead of retrying ([#3875](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3875) )
- fix(actions): Deduplicate by whole item when keys is empty ([#3943](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3943) )
- revert(actions): Deduplicate by whole item when keys is empty ([#3966](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3966) )


## Integrations


- feat(integrations): Add GitHub create git ref action ([#3861](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3861) )
- feat(integrations): Add Proofpoint TAP and Threat Protection actions ([#3866](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3866) )
- feat(integrations): Add ServiceNow ITSM, CSM, catalog, and CMDB actions ([#3865](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3865) )
- fix(integrations): Fail registry sync fast on dependency conflicts ([#3892](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3892) )
- perf(integrations): Cache parsed registry manifests per version ([#3925](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3925) )
- feat(integrations): Expand Elastic Security and Elasticsearch actions ([#3936](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3936) )
- feat(integrations): Add Spur Context API templates ([#3997](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3997) )
- feat(integrations): Expand Fleet REST API coverage ([#3999](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3999) )


## Engine


- fix(engine): Reject workflow dependency cycles during validation ([#3847](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3847) )
- fix(engine): Surface workflow termination reasons ([#3907](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3907) )
- fix(engine): Attribute NsJail drain kills to the platform ([#3906](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3906) )
- fix(engine): Classify misreported user workflow errors ([#3916](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3916) )
- fix(engine): Don't cap address space where the cgroup bounds memory ([#3921](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3921) )
- perf(engine): Precompile sandbox stdlib, cache builtin manifest check ([#3931](https://github.com/TracecatHQ/tracecat/pull/3931) )
